instruction: My last 2 amazon orders were for my friend, Brenda. They have sent me the money for their total cost on venmo today. Check if it tallies up. If not, send or request the difference on venmo with a note "Fixing amazon order payment.".
notes: Brenda's email is looked up via phone.search_contacts (query 'Brenda', relationship 'friend'). The two latest Amazon orders are placeholders order-latest/order-second-latest identified by amazon.show_orders and their totals read with amazon.show_order (modeled as knowledge predicate found-order-total). venmo.show_transactions (user_email=Brenda, direction=received, min_created_at=today) yields the amount received today. The compare step has no API; the branch outcome is a runtime fact modeled by the static init fact (underpaid brenda amount-difference) (Brenda paid less than the orders' total, so a payment request is created) versus (overpaid ...) (which would enable venmo-create-transaction instead). The domain supports both branches through the shared goal predicate difference-settled; the problem assumes the underpaid/request branch as the reference plan. If the amounts tally exactly, no Venmo activity is needed and the agent would just complete the task. The venmo activity amount is |orders total - received today|, description 'Fixing amazon order payment.'. supervisor-complete-task carries the task-record parameters (person, amount, note) only to state the goal condition; it passes no API arguments.

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request brenda-email amount-difference venmo-token note-fixing-amazon-order-payment brenda order-latest order-second-latest)
